js: __vehicle.getState().set({gear:'D',speedOverride:30,parkingBrake:false});await __sleep(6000);const root=parseFloat(getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).fontSize);const scale=root/16;const out={root,scale,small:[],clip:[]};for(const b of document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=cockpit] button,[data-testid=cockpit] [role=radio],[data-testid=cockpit] [role=switch]')){const r=b.getBoundingClientRect();if(!r.width||!r.height)continue;const w=r.width/scale,h=r.height/scale;if(Math.min(w,h)<56)out.small.push((b.getAttribute('aria-label')||b.textContent.trim().slice(0,18))+' '+Math.round(w)+'x'+Math.round(h))}for(const e of document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=cockpit] *')){if(e.children.length===0&&e.textContent.trim()&&e.scrollWidth>e.clientWidth+1&&getComputedStyle(e).overflow!=='visible'&&getComputedStyle(e).textOverflow!=='ellipsis')out.clip.push(e.textContent.trim().slice(0,30))}return JSON.stringify(out)
